reason: This PR changes plan-cache behavior by adding metadata locking around cached plans, which directly affects planner semantics, executor/runtime correctness, and session-level schema visibility guarantees. The touched paths are broad and central (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache*.go`, `pkg/executor/*`, `pkg/session/session.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go`, `pkg/parser/model/model.go`, plus server/meta integration), so regressions could plausibly surface as stale-plan execution, wrong-schema access, lock/lifecycle bugs, or session/protocol correctness issues. That is high-blast-radius enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High problems.
